title: Bored of slow love? Try instant romance.
caption: Flowers, fireworks and "soulmate" on day one feel thrilling. But most meteors are just dust burning up in the air. Slow and steady love isn't boring, it's the kind that lasts. Send this to the friend who's already picking baby names.
